visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a navy blue puffer jacket is seen standing in front of a yellow crane machine labeled 'LUCKY MONKEY'. He is operating the joystick and buttons while a man stands beside him, providing guidance. The machine is filled with green plastic bags containing toys. (2) The crane attempts to grab a bag but fails as it slips. The boy continues to try, with the man's hands occasionally appearing to assist him with the machine's controls. (3) The man takes over the operation, successfully grabbing a bag and dropping it into the prize chute. The boy looks on with anticipation. (4) The boy is then shown holding a won prize—a green package containing a toy truck set. The scene shifts to another crane machine filled with white branded cups, which the boy attempts to catch. (5) A different machine filled with blue Pocari Sweat bottles is shown. The boy and the man work together to successfully catch several bottles. (6) The final shot shows a yellow shopping basket overflowing with various prizes, including toy sets, drinks, and snacks, being pushed across the arcade floor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic Japanese J-pop track featuring female vocals. The child's voice is heard high-pitched and excited, interacting with an adult male's lower-pitched, encouraging tone. Mechanical sounds of the crane machine joystick clicking and the internal motor humming are prominent. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect is added in post-production as the boy presses a button. The father speaks rapidly with a friendly tone, instructing the boy. (3) A loud thud is heard as a prize drops into the metal chute. The father's voice expresses joyful surprise. (4) The background music continues with a strong electronic beat. The girl's voice enters briefly with a high-pitched exclamation. Sound effects like magical 'pops' and sparkles are layered over the transitions. (5) The video concludes with the father speaking with a humorous, proud tone about their haul, while the music swells in volume before a hard cut to silence.
